text_zh: 「时之沙漏倒悬——汝之祷声将成汝之审判」
text_en: "The hourglass inverts—thy litany becomes thy judgment"

text_zh:
残余异文: RA-███ · 镜沫回响
归属 Boss: 第 XII 层 · 祷文引擎
持续效应: 引擎核心镜面化，映射前一次收容失败之影。时序逆流，沙漏倒悬。超越既定节拍者将遭遇完全时流断绝。
备注: 现象首次记录于 M.2██，与 D-████ 的二次登塔尝试同期出现。该人员档案已转移至 ████████。
"镜中之影非为幻象，乃是引擎对失败者的慈悲重演。" —— 末席守卷人手记残片
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-███ · Mirrored Resonance
Host Entity: Layer XII · The Litany Engine
Persistent Effect: Engine core exhibits reflective properties, manifesting echoes of prior containment failures. Temporal flow inverts, hourglass suspended. Subjects exceeding established rhythm experience complete chronological severance.
Note: First documented M.2██, concurrent with D-████'s secondary ascent attempt. Personnel file relocated to ████████.
"The mirror's reflection is no illusion, but the Engine's mercy—a second rendering of failure." —— Fragment from Last Signatory's notes
